mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY product_id DESC

SELECT rental_price_id AS rentalPriceId, duration, monthly_fee AS monthlyFee, deposit_fee AS depositFee, is_b2b_only AS b2bOnly FROM rental_prices WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY duration
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, name, brand, model_name, is_purchasable, base_price, is_rentable, rental_price, stock_quantity, description, image_url) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{brand}, #{modelName}, #{isPurchasable}, #{basePrice}, #{isRentable}, #{rentalPrice}, #{stockQuantity}, #{description}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, brand = #{brand}, model_name = #{modelName}, is_purchasable = #{isPurchasable}, base_price = #{basePrice}, is_rentable = #{isRentable}, rental_price = #{rentalPrice}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, description = #{description}, image_url = #{imageUrl} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
